note: Hand-curated. Every fact comes from the program's official page. 'next' is filled in only once the official page announces the dates. collectors/programs-check.mjs re-reads each 'check_url' daily and sets 'check.seen' when the dates on that page change; a person then reviews the entry and copies 'check.seen' into 'check.reviewed'.

programs.name: Google Summer of Code
programs.summary: Spend a summer writing code for an open-source organization, with mentors from that organization.
programs.who: Students and people new to open source, aged 18 or over.
programs.stipend: Paid by Google. The amount depends on the project's size and the contributor's country.
programs.usual: Contributor applications usually open in March for about two weeks. Coding runs from about June.
programs.last_edition: 2026: contributor applications ran from 16 to 31 March 2026.

programs.name: LFX Mentorship
programs.summary: Paid mentorships on Linux Foundation projects such as the Linux kernel and CNCF projects.
programs.who: Anyone. Each project lists its own requirements.
programs.stipend: Paid. The amount depends on the mentee's country.
programs.usual: Several terms each year. Each project opens its own applications before its term.

programs.name: Outreachy
programs.summary: Paid, remote internships in open source and open science.
programs.who: People subject to systemic bias or under-represented in tech, who can work on the internship full time.
programs.stipend: Paid. See the official site for the current amount.
programs.usual: Two cohorts a year, starting in May and December. Initial applications open a few months before each cohort.
programs.last_edition: December 2026 cohort: internships run from 7 December 2026 to 8 March 2027. Its applications have closed.

programs.name: Hacktoberfest
programs.summary: A month of contributing to open-source projects, with online and in-person events.
programs.who: Anyone, from first-time contributors to maintainers.
programs.usual: Every October, from the 1st to the 31st.
programs.last_edition: 2026: ran through October and ended on 31 October 2026.

programs.name: GirlScript Summer of Code
programs.summary: A large open-source program run from India, with mentors, project admins and a points leaderboard.
programs.who: Students and beginners. Open to everyone.
programs.usual: Runs in the summer. Applications open a few weeks before the kick-off.
programs.last_edition: 2026: kick-off on 3 April 2026; the program closed on 16 August 2026.

programs.name: Season of KDE
programs.summary: KDE's own mentorship program, held every year since 2013, for code and non-code projects.
programs.who: Anyone who wants to contribute to KDE.
programs.usual: Applications open in mid-December and close in mid-January. Work runs from late January to late March. Certificates and swag are sent out after the program.
programs.last_edition: 2026: contributor applications from 15 December 2025 to 14 January 2026; work from 23 January to 20 March 2026.

programs.name: Summer of Bitcoin
programs.summary: A summer internship on bitcoin and lightning open-source projects, with established developers as mentors.

programs.name: FOSSEE Summer Fellowship
programs.summary: A summer internship on free and open-source software for education and research, run by IIT Bombay.
programs.who: Students in India. Each project lists its own requirements.
programs.format: On campus or remote, full time or part time
programs.usual: Registration usually opens in March. The internship runs from about mid-May to mid-July.
programs.last_edition: The latest dates on the official page are for 2025: registration from 11 March to 9 April 2025.
